discrepancies: Every reviewed line is byte-identical to the committed legal resource. No source wording was corrected. Title-terminal periods in Chronicle of the Righteous, Dungeons of Golarion and Inner Sea Magic are retained in the Registry titles. Chronicle of the Righteous literally has © 2013 Paizo without a comma after the year; Dungeons of Golarion separates the publisher and Authors: with a period rather than a semicolon. Inner Sea Gods literally names Sean K Reynolds, with Amanda Hamon and the following contributors; no abbreviation, personal-name alias or extra conjunction is invented. Paizo Publishing, LLC versus Paizo Inc., singular versus plural contributor labels and all dates/punctuation remain literal. comparisons.result: Castles of the Inner Sea and Demons Revisited literally use © 2013, Paizo Publishing, LLC;. Cheliax uses © 2015, Paizo Inc.; and Darklands Revisited uses © 2016, Paizo Inc.;. Chronicle of the Righteous. literally uses © 2013 Paizo Publishing, LLC; without a comma after the year and names Amber Scott. Title-terminal punctuation and singular/plural contributor labels remain unchanged; no release-date or personal-name correction is inferred.

Distant Realms, Distant Shores and Heaven Unleashed literally use Paizo Inc.; with years 2018, 2015 and 2016 respectively. Dragon Empires Gazetteer and Dungeons of Golarion use © 2011, Paizo Publishing, LLC. Dungeons of Golarion. has a title-terminal period and publisher-terminal period before Authors:. All literal contributor spellings, including Owen K.C. Stephens and Amanda Hamon Kunz, remain unchanged.

Horsemen of the Apocalypse: Book of the Damned, Vol. 3 uses © 2011 and singular Author: Todd Stewart. Inner Sea Combat and Inner Sea Monster Codex use © 2014 and © 2015, Paizo Inc.; respectively. Inner Sea Gods uses © 2014, Paizo Publishing, LLC; Authors: Sean K Reynolds, with Amanda Hamon and the following contributors. Inner Sea Magic. uses © 2011 with its title-terminal period and comma-separated author list. No personal-name aliases or missing conjunctions are inferred.
